About Astrid Moon Cattery

Raised With Purpose.
Loved From Day One.

Astrid Moon Cattery is a TICA-registered cattery in Austin, Texas. We raise Bicolor, Mitted, and Colorpoint Ragdolls in a loving, cage-free environment — handled daily, socialized with care, and ready to join your family with confidence.

  • HEALTHDNA-tested breeding cats and comprehensive veterinary care.
  • TEMPERAMENTRaised underfoot, handled daily, and known as individuals.
  • BREED STANDARDThoughtful pairings selected for type, structure, coat, and expression.
  • LIFELONG SUPPORTGuidance before adoption and long after your kitten goes home.
Discover Our Story→

Kitten Adoption Process

    Submit a Kitten Application

    To be considered for adoption, all prospective families must complete a Kitten Application. We review each application carefully to ensure our kittens go to loving forever homes.

    Apply for a Kitten →

    Reserve Your Kitten

    Our kittens are $4,500. If your application is approved, you'll get access to our available kittens and can place a $1,000 deposit to reserve yours — the deposit applies toward the total, with the $3,500 balance due before pickup.

    Stay in the Loop

    Once your application is approved, stay connected every step of the way. Follow us on social media, subscribe to our blog for breed tips and cattery updates, or join our newsletter for kitten availability alerts straight to your inbox.

Deposits are non-refundable, and apply toward the total. See pricing, payment and go-home details.

All About Your Ragdoll Kitten

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick and clear answers to help you adopt and care for your Ragdoll kitten.

How much are your kittens?

$4,500 per kitten, flat — the same price regardless of color, pattern, sex or eye color. A $1,000 non-refundable deposit reserves your kitten, and the $3,500 balance is due before pickup.

What age are the kittens available for adoption?

Families usually meet the kittens and choose around 6-8 weeks. Early spay/neuter is done at approximately 11-12 weeks, and kittens go home at 12 weeks or older, once they have recovered from surgery and been cleared by our veterinarian, with microchipping and age-appropriate vaccinations complete. Some kittens stay longer when they need it.

Do you health test your cats?

Yes. Every cat in our breeding program has a genetic panel run. Those panels include the HCM-associated mutation and the PKD1 mutation, along with coat, color and blood type. To be precise about what that means: genetic testing tells you whether a cat carries a specific known mutation. It is not the same as a cardiac ultrasound, and we don't describe our cats as "heart tested." Every kitten also has a veterinary clearance exam before going home.

Can I see the kittens before adoption?

In person, yes — once your application is approved and your deposit is placed, we'll arrange a time for you to come and meet them.

Before that, you can see more than a scheduled call would ever show you. We keep a public, standing video record: years of video filmed inside our own home and cattery across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube, plus a feature on The Cat Butler, a third-party channel we don't control. You don't have to ask and you don't have to wait — it's all there right now, and it's a deeper and more current picture than one call could give.

Same name, same Austin, Texas location, same email address everywhere you find us.

Have a question about a specific kitten? Email astridmooncattery@gmail.com.

Do you ship kittens?

We don't ship kittens as cargo. For families outside driving distance we arrange a flight nanny, who carries your kitten in the cabin as their own carry-on and hands them to you the same day. Closer to home, we offer pickup in Austin, Texas, or — depending on your location — we can meet partway or arrange ground delivery for a fee.
